english.title: Failed to comply / prevented another person from complying with requirement / direction under the Ivory Act 2018
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) you

(A)_[failed without reasonable excuse to comply]_
(B)_[prevented another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), from complying]_

with a requirement reasonably made or direction reasonably given, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT OR DIRECTION..) by an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..) acting in the exercise of their powers under sections 15 to 25 of the Ivory Act 2018
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28(2) and (4) of the Ivory Act 2018.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
